params.1292: Completing this Task will give an amount of money based on total Tasks completed, a sapphire necklace and ten cosmic runes.
params.1274: You will need level 3 Magic to cast this spell.
params.1275: You will also need 3 water runes, 2 earth runes and 1 body rune. The magic shop in Varrock sells these.
params.1276: Open your Magic Spellbook and click on the Confuse spell.
params.1277: Click on an enemy to cast Confuse on it.
